scripts.analyze: NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation" VITE_ANALYZE_BUNDLE=true vite build && node -e "console.log('\\nBundle analysis generated at dist/stats.html')"
scripts.quality: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip && pnpm -s quality:nose
scripts.quality:fix: pnpm -s fmt:fix && pnpm -s lint:fix && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s knip
scripts.quality:ci: pnpm -s fmt && pnpm -s lint && pnpm -s check && pnpm -s circular && pnpm -s quality:nose
scripts.quality:nose: bash -c 'if command -v nose &>/dev/null; then nose query src --baseline .nose-baseline.json --fail-on new; else echo "[nose] not installed — skipping"; fi'
scripts.mut: cd test && npx stryker run stryker.conf.json --reporters=progress
scripts.mut:fast: cd test && npx stryker run stryker.conf.json --reporters=progress --mutators=boolean,arithmetic,conditional-boundary,equality-operator,negate-conditional,string
